name: English Knowledge Base Composite Textpack
description: Generated source-backed English KB recipe composite for WordNet lexical-semantic resources and a local Wikidata English core entity extract.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated recipe composite over Open English WordNet and a local task-supported Wikidata English core entity extract. Open English WordNet provides lexical-semantic KB resources; Wikidata provides local entity, alias, relation, canonical KB, quality, and evaluation resources for its declared extract scope.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: The Open English WordNet and Wikidata main structured source rows are approved; required component packages carry package-local license evidence for Open English WordNet, Princeton WordNet lineage, and Wikidata CC0 structured data.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: English KB component composite backed by Open English WordNet lexical semantics and a Wikidata English core entity extract. It does not claim full Wikidata dump coverage, full named-entity-linking coverage, morphology, syntax, corpus, parallel, or full language-composite coverage.

components.reason: Default English lexical-semantic WordNet KB resources.
Default English Wikidata core entity labels, aliases, relations, and canonical KB extract.

notes: The required component graph provides English WordNet synsets, senses, lexical entries, semantic relations, and local Wikidata English core entity rows, aliases, and relations.
Generated component reports and evaluation records are available for the required KB component graph.
